title: Australian companies face ‘AI washing’ claims after wave of job cuts, offshoring
llm_summary: Australian firms are being accused of “AI washing” after a spate of layoffs and off‑shoring moves that were framed as technology‑driven transformations. Critics say many companies are using buzz‑word‑heavy AI narratives to justify cutting staff and moving work overseas, rather than delivering genuine AI innovation. The backlash highlights growing skepticism about corporate claims that AI alone is reshaping the workforce.
